entities.summary: The Pinzgauer Lokalbahn is a narrow-gauge railway in Salzburg in Austria. The 53-kilometre (33 mi) railway follows the Salzach valley from Zell am See to Krimml through the Pinzgau mountains. The section between Mittersill and Krimml was damaged by flooding in 2005 and reopened in September 2010.
